ignorePatterns:
gen/**
src/vendor/**
locales/*.json
package-lock.json
go.sum
buf.lock
**/testdata/**
wishicons/bank.json
docs/site/fonts/**
docs/screenshots/**
build/**

rules.rule: No secret, ever: Djinn may pass a secret to a process, but never stores, logs or reads one. Flag a token, key or password written to the store, a log, a file, a plan block or a test fixture (CONTRIBUTING.md, Technical directions).
Tests never call a model: providers replay recorded streams (docs/providers.md). Flag a test that starts a real claude, codex or agy, or reaches a provider's API.
Tests touch only what they started: stop a process by its PID, never by name; never dial or write to the Djinn of the person running the tests (CONTRIBUTING.md, Djinn builds Djinn).

Go tests follow CONTRIBUTING.md, Writing tests: one TestFunction per function beside its source, cases in a t.Run table, t.Parallel() or a comment saying why not, no time.Sleep (a fake clock, a short tick or an event wait instead), under 2 s.
Tasks are portable: no Unix-only tool in Taskfile.yml (write a small Go command in tools/ instead), {{exeExt}} for binaries; filepath and os.UserConfigDir in Go, path in Node.

Protos under api/ are the source of truth for the API, command line, storage and config; gen/** is generated from them by go tool task gen. A new command follows docs/cli-convention.md with no code per command, and its proto comment is its documentation.
What the lead adds to a wish's plan is smoke unless the code computes on it: a block, not a new proto field. Flag a new plan field that no code reads (CONTRIBUTING.md, The lamp and the smoke).
A file of one agent's own, such as .claude/settings.json, follows from .agents/: a change to it without the matching change under .agents/ is a hand edit that a test will refuse.

A field the developer types free text in is a TextField or a TextLine (src/text-field.tsx), never a controlled <textarea> or <input>; its owner keeps the text in useTyped or a store of its own and reads it with read() in a handler (AGENTS.md, Interface).
A list being read never moves under the reader: new items append below, a revision keeps an item's place, and the scroll stays anchored on what is on screen (src/scroll-anchor.ts).
A rounded element has a uniform border on all sides, or none: never a one-sided border or a thicker accent border on one side of a rounded card.

Every text a person reads is a key of locales/en.json, read with t() in the interface or locales.T in Go, translated in the same change; never a literal string in a component, and never a key built from a template literal.
The repository is in English, with no company's internal names in code or docs; French belongs only in locales/fr.json.

A new Go module or npm package needs a license from the allowed list (MIT, BSD, ISC, Apache-2.0; MPL-2.0 only unmodified) and its name in the PR description; copied code is credited in docs/THIRD_PARTY_NOTICES.md (CONTRIBUTING.md, Licenses).
